name: Work item
about: Track a focused platform implementation or architecture task
title: ""
labels: ""
assignees: ""
---

## Goal

What outcome should this issue produce?

## Scope

What is included?

## Out of scope

What should explicitly not be changed here?

## Canonical ownership

Name the platform-owned domain, contract or service that owns this work. Do not create a client-private or provider-private competing contract.

## Hard dependencies

List only issues, contracts or decisions that must land before this issue can be completed. Use `None` when there are no blockers.

## Follow-up integrations

List related consumers or later integrations that do not block completion. Use `None` when there are none.

## Deliverables

List code, documentation, tests or decision records expected.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Outcome is testable or reviewable.
- [ ] Relevant documentation is updated.
- [ ] New upstream dependencies, if any, have provenance/license review.

## Required tests

List the automated and manual evidence required to close the issue.

## Definition of Done

State the observable condition that proves the issue is complete.

## Planning metadata

- [ ] Exactly one `type:*` label is assigned.
- [ ] Exactly one `area:*` label is assigned.
- [ ] Exactly one `stage:*` label is assigned.
- [ ] The issue is assigned to the milestone whose outcome it is required to satisfy.
